# FocusHop 1.0.5
This preview fixes activation failures under load. It continues to use the Lemon Squeezy test store.
- Keep Clicking available when optional native-chrome discovery is incomplete or changes during a scan. Window and menu identity checks, and individual control visibility checks, remain in place. - Prevent repeated focus notifications from continually restarting Vim setup. Recover temporary Accessibility failures with bounded retries, and give activation user-initiated priority. - Register the Vim focus observer off the main thread and avoid unnecessary attribute discovery for known multiline text areas. - Measure Fast jk using key timestamps, so delayed callbacks do not make a physically fast gesture appear slow. Genuinely slow gestures remain ordinary text input.
The release includes paired benchmark reports. Hosted CI measurements cover retained search matching and available offscreen Metal rendering; live AX and compositor measurements require a physical Mac.

# FocusHop 1.0.4
This preview improves Vim editing, autocomplete selection and visible native window controls. It continues to use the Lemon Squeezy test store.
- Keep Vim editing active when a single-line field cannot accept a line-opening command. The command leaves its text and cursor unchanged. - Handle multiline inputs exposed as autocomplete comboboxes without assuming that a one-row appearance means single-line editing. - Discover individually actionable suggestions inside autocomplete controls, while continuing to exclude hidden, covered, disabled and passive content. - Discover visible full-screen native tabs and application menu-bar entries through their accessibility relationships. Hidden and covered controls remain excluded. - Include downloadable JSON and Markdown benchmark reports with every release. Compare retained search matching and available offscreen Metal drawing measurements against the validated baseline on the same runner, with clear scope and slowdown warnings. Full AX and compositor measurements remain separate physical-Mac checks.

# FocusHop 1.0.3
This preview fixes Vim sessions ending when a rich-text editor replaces its accessibility objects after deletion. It continues to use the Lemon Squeezy test store.
- Keep Vim active after confirmed edits replace an input inside the same editing container, including deleting its last line and typing again. - Preserve quick `jk` and automatic Insert sessions through the same verified transitions. - Continue ending the session when focus moves elsewhere or the replacement cannot be safely verified. - Allow failed release publication to resume safely, reusing verified published installers and repairing the signed update feed without replacing released files.

# FocusHop 1.0.2
This preview adds a DMG installer and provides the next signed update for testing from FocusHop 1.0.1. It continues to use the Lemon Squeezy test store.
- Install manually by opening the signed, notarized DMG and dragging FocusHop to Applications. - Keep the ZIP download available for Sparkle updates through the signed preview feed. - Verify either download against the published SHA-256 checksums.

# FocusHop 1.0.1
This preview adds clearer account settings and a consistent path to subscription checkout. It uses the Lemon Squeezy test store.
- Open subscription checkout in your browser. - Find the app version, company website, and third-party acknowledgments on the new About page. - Improve settings alignment and keep application overrides from changing the window size. - Fix an accessibility crash when reading active-license account information. - Allow a previously validated license to work offline for up to seven days.
- Check for and install signed updates with Sparkle from About or the menu bar, with an automatic-check preference stored in the settings JSON.
